title: Sieve admin API starts in open state if bound to non-loopback without token
description: smtp/sieve_admin.rs:91-98: warns if non-loopback + no bearer_token, but still starts. Any unauthenticated HTTP client on the network can upload/delete Sieve scripts. Fix: fail-closed — refuse to start if listen addr is non-loopback and no bearer_token is set. The warning-only approach creates a false sense that the operator was warned and thus things are fine.
